$comment: Tool loadout per role (spec: factory/automation.md rows 4-6; docs/extensions.md 'Tool Exposure' + prepareLoadout; examples/extensions/preset.ts). `descriptions` replaces each tool's model-facing description with a short one, cutting the first request's input tokens; `roles[role].tools` replaces the default active set. The built-in `read` (300-line cap) and `bash` (4 KB tail) are overridden by factory/extensions/loadout.ts. A role is matched from the agent's system prompt: 'You are a pirust <role>'.

descriptions.read: Read a file. Text is capped at 300 lines; pass offset/limit to page a longer file. Images are returned as attachments.
descriptions.bash: Run a bash command; returns stdout+stderr. Output is capped to the last 4 KB. Optional timeout in seconds.
descriptions.edit: Edit a file with exact oldText/newText replacements. Every oldText must match one unique, non-overlapping region.
descriptions.write: Create a file, overwriting if it exists; parent dirs are created. Use only for new files or full rewrites.
descriptions.grep: Search file contents for a string; returns matching lines as file:line.
descriptions.find: Find files by glob; returns matching paths.
descriptions.ls: List a directory; returns its entries.
